floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a villa or original community drawing
floorPlans.note: Each villa spread includes both floors and its original notices. Total unit area and total gross area follow separate printed definitions. Bliss I prints 651 m² unit area, although its metric component rows sum to 621 m². Its carport pair, 49 m² and 853 sq ft, also conflicts. Spark II lists an extra guest room while its heading and current factsheet specify four bedrooms. Original plot ranges and imperial figures differ from the current factsheet. Six garden variants listed there lack individual drawings in these brochures. Confirm the contracted type, plot, revision, bedroom count and final area.

review.imagery: Root reviewed all original 51 brochure spreads and all 30 extracted native resources. Twenty-four villa exterior renders cover the twelve named types. Six interior concepts preserve their published scheme labels. Original embedded image bytes and source-PDF physical pages remain attributable. No stock lifestyle or another phase was substituted.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all fourteen delivered complete drawings and all 24 visible villa numeric panels. Twelve home spreads retain both ground and upper levels. Original master and regional sheets provide community context. Bliss I metric components total 621 versus its 651 headline, and its 49 m²/853 sq ft carport pair conflicts. Spark II room-table guest entry conflicts with its four-bedroom heading. Several component sums differ by one square metre under independent rounding. Earlier imperial and plot figures differ from the current factsheet. Source values remain visible, uncorrected. Six garden variants have no individual drawing in this public set.
review.location: Root read complete original regional brochure page 10, master page 9 and current factsheet page 3. Five community driving estimates remain source-qualified. No exact villa entrance, surveyed pin, current live route or kilometre journey inferred.
review.provenance: Normal-GET receipts preserve original URLs, dates, bytes and SHA256 for three public brochure parts, current factsheet and regional brochure. Broker mirrors remain labelled. Whole drawing spreads retain notices and original PDFs. Protected text research and identities remain preserved.

unavailable: Individual garden-variant drawings, final contracted revision, confirmed plot and finishes, surveyed villa entrance coordinates and kilometre journeys remain unavailable or unverified. Bliss I source area inconsistencies and Spark II bedroom-list conflict remain unresolved.
